fusions.name: Singled Out
fusions.desc: Flicks the tip at the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Blinding Backhand
fusions.desc: Lashes across the faces of everything in a cone, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, stuns each for 1 second and leaves it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Far as the Gaze
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Every Stripe Noted
fusions.desc: You deal 12% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions.
